rows.label: tlk70000009_05_msg0001
rows.name:
My older brother and I are here, so
you can relax. We won't let even one
mouse through.

rows.label: tlk70000009_05_msg0002
rows.name:
We're not just protecting a gate.
We're guarding the future of
everyone in Iira's capital.

rows.label: tlk70000009_05_msg0003
rows.name:
It's worth protecting, isn't it? My
older brother said it gives him a
warrior's shiver.

rows.label: tlk70000009_05_msg0004
rows.name:
To be honest, I'm still a
little bit apprehensive
about meeting the enemy.

rows.label: tlk70000009_05_msg0005
rows.name:
But you're carrying heavier burdens
and diving right into their midst. I
can't sit here complaining.
